periods.time: Final selection day, before Ikki vs Toka

name.zh: 一辉回到破军并接受众人声援
name.en: Ikki Returns to Hagun and Accepts Everyone's Support

periods.location: Road to Hagun Academy and front gate
periods.summary: Akaza abandons the sick Ikki to reach Hagun alone. Ikki nearly collapses into hallucinations of snow and past rejection, but Shizuku catches him at the gate and a crowd of students cheers him onward.
periods.cause: Akaza hopes Ikki will miss the match or arrive too weak to fight.
periods.process: Ikki's body is near failure and his mind is tempted to rest. The memory of a red-haired promise keeps him walking. Shizuku, Kagami, Ayase, Renren, Ikazuchi, Oreki and other students gathered by Shizuku call his name and tell him he is their hero.
periods.outcome: Ikki realizes he also carries others' expectations, recovers his resolve, and heads toward the arena.
periods.significance: Reverses Ikki's isolation and gives him the emotional strength needed to challenge Toka.
